cp7:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi Ekarājassa atrajo nagare Pupphavatiyā kumāro Candasa' vhayo, || ||
cp7:2.1: Tadā' haṃ yajanā mutto nikkhanto yaññavāṭato saṃvegaṃ janayitvāna mahādānaṃ pavattayiṃ. || ||
cp7:3.1: Nāhaṃ pivāmi khādāmi na pi bhuñjāmi bhojanaṃ dakkhiṇeyye adatvāna api chappañca rattiyo. || ||
cp7:4.1: Yathā pi vāṇijo nāma katvāna bhaṇḍasañcayaṃ yattha lābho mahā hoti tattha naṃ harati bhaṇḍakaṃ, || ||
cp7:5.1: Tath' eva sakabhuttā pi pare dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ; tasmā parassa dātabbaṃ, satabhāgo bhavissati. || ||
cp7:6.1: Etaṃ-atthavasaṃ ñatvā demi dānaṃ bhavābhave na paṭikkamāmi dānato sambodhim-anupattiyā 'ti. || ||
